meta_description: John Spencer Decorators in Newcastle offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full redecoration. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert painting, wallpapering, and interior finishing. Free no-obligation quote — call today.
services_heading: Interior and Exterior Decorating Services Newcastle
services_subhead: From a fresh coat of paint to complete room makeovers, we handle every aspect of domestic and commercial decoration.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Quality emulsion and gloss work to bedrooms, lounges, kitchens and hallways. We protect your furniture, prepare surfaces properly, and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Durable masonry paint and woodwork finishes for weatherproof protection. Includes fascia, soffits, doors, and window frames using premium exterior-grade paints.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert hanging of patterned and plain wallcoverings to suit any room style. We handle feature walls, stairwells, and tricky corners with precision.

services.title: Textured Coatings
services.desc: Artex and polished plaster finishes for ceilings and walls. Creates visual interest and can hide minor imperfections while adding character to period properties.

services.title: Woodwork and Trim
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, architraves and shutters painted to a factory finish. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for durability and depth of colour.

services.title: Full Room Redecoration
services.desc: Complete makeovers including preparation, painting walls and ceilings, and final touches. We project-manage from start to finish so you can relax.

about_pullquote: I do this work the way I'd want it done in my own home—no shortcuts.
about_para_1: John Spencer Decorators has been serving Newcastle and surrounding areas for over 20 years. I started out as an apprentice and built this business on honest pricing, reliable turnaround, and genuine craftsmanship. Every job, whether a single room or a whole-house redecoration, is treated with the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on repeat customers and word-of-mouth recommendations across Newcastle. We take pride in thorough surface preparation, expert colour advice, and tidy working practices. When you hire us, you get someone who shows up on time, communicates clearly, and leaves your home in pristine condition.

reviews.text: John painted my entire lounge and hallway. The prep work was immaculate, he protected everything, and the finish is flawless. Arrived on time, tidy, and gave genuine advice on colours. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had him wallpaper two feature walls in our bedroom. Tricky angles, but he made it look easy. Professionally done, no bubbles, no mess. Great bloke and fair pricing. Will definitely call him again.
reviews.author: Emma W.

reviews.text: Exterior paint job on our Victorian terrace. John explained everything, sourced the right paint for period properties, and the result looks like new. Worth every penny. Five stars.
reviews.author: Robert H.
